content: We evaluate the performance of RAMEN+RoBERTa$_{\textsc {base}}$ (initialized from monolingual data) at each training steps: initialization of word embeddings (0K update), fine-tuning target embeddings (25K), and fine-tuning the model on both English and target language (at each 25K updates). The results are presented in Figure FIGREF40.
